analysis_type: Post-experiment exploratory descriptive diagnostics; no new model evaluations or human annotations.

cohort.missingness_rule: Incomplete cases are excluded from all comparisons, never assigned zero.

aggregation: Native and sensitivity means give each paired disclosure equal weight. Pooled rates give each native claim equal weight. Exact-text rates use only the selected unique literal pairs.

non_disclosure_sensitivity.limit: Removes only BACE-unsupported DCs diagnosed as non_disclosure_statement, not all non-disclosure assertions. This changes the estimand and is not a corrected accuracy estimate.

zero_candidates.limit: An arithmetic upper bound for relabeling this subset only, not an estimate or bound for all extraction/candidate errors. Nonempty candidate sets can omit decisive premises. Actual support of zero-candidate DCs was not assessed. This scenario overlaps with the non-disclosure sensitivity and must not be added to it.

ragchecker.limit: Equal counts do not align propositions. These selected descriptive groups cannot identify a causal segmentation effect.

ragas.limit: Equal counts do not align propositions. These selected descriptive groups cannot identify a causal segmentation effect.

ragchecker.limit: Casefold and whitespace-normalized unique text matching within case; no semantic alignment. Verdicts are saved automated outcomes, not human truth. Selected overlap is not representative. Same wording removes one representation difference but leaves evidence representation and judgment procedures different.

ragas.limit: Casefold and whitespace-normalized unique text matching within case; no semantic alignment. Verdicts are saved automated outcomes, not human truth. Selected overlap is not representative. Same wording removes one representation difference but leaves evidence representation and judgment procedures different.

inference.independence: Claims are nested in disclosures and companies. No independence-based inference is made.
